notes.title: The Voice in the Void Version 1.1
notes.notes:
The Voice in the Void has been updated to version 1.1! This update includes many changes, tweaks, and improvements to make the game a more enjoyable experience.

Patch Notes:

-Doubled the framerate across the entire game (i.e. 30 to 60 fps)
-Fixed an error that was causing the game to not launch on some computers
-Re-balanced some enemy encounters
-Increased the player character's movement speed
-Improved the save/load game menus
-Added new music
-Added more HP/TP restore points to the overworld
-Added more messages to the start of combat
-Reworked how fleeing from battle works
-Equalized volume of music and sound effects to make it more uniform
-Changed the text sound effect
-Fixed various bugs
-fixed some grammatical errors in dialogue

Enjoy!
